principle_violations.reason: The Order class has responsibilities related to managing items and their details as well as containing business logic for handling order status. The PaymentProcessor and its subclasses are directly modifying the order status, which should be managed elsewhere.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order management and payment processing responsibilities. Consider implementing an OrderManager to handle order state changes based on payment processing.

principle_violations.reason: The payment processing logic in the CreditCardPaymentProcessor, DebitCardPaymentProcessor, and PaypalPaymentProcessor has code duplication in verifying security codes and changing the order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a common method for the verification process and order status update to eliminate duplication.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
